target.outcome: Accumulated confirmed COVID-19 cases and deaths by region-day (principal published count outcomes)
target.pollutant: SO2 principal; NO2, O3, PM2.5, and PM10 reconstructed as additional declared contrasts
target.effect_scale: Native log rate ratio and exp(beta) RR per 1 ug/m3

substitutions.reason: The independent national regional time series begins 2020-02-24; the unavailable dates were not imputed.

substitutions.reanalysis: Independent aggregation of raw EEA E1a station observations with GADM polygon assignment

substitutions.published: Calendar-complete long-term mean implied by 2013--2020 period

substitutions.reanalysis: No valid principal fit; specified-form diagnostic fits retained only
substitutions.reason: The substituted outcome period has no pre-lockdown observations, so lockdown is constant and collinear with intercept; only two GEE clusters also invalidate robust inference.

coverage.notes: Both regions have all 86 available outcome dates and complete STAP values. Long-term exposure has 2,331 observed dates rather than 2,696 calendar dates per pollutant-region.

blockers: The lockdown covariate is constant after the unavoidable public-outcome date substitution and is perfectly collinear with the intercept.
Only two regional clusters are available for AR(1) GEE; robust covariance warnings and diagnostic intervals are not valid inferential confidence intervals.
